I can't make all of it make sense here, but a grown-up who cares about you can be right beside you to help — that's why telling someone matters so much. Who is a grown-up you could talk to?

Please share this with a grown-up you trust — a teacher, a school counselor, or another safe adult — as soon as you can. Is there someone like that you could go to?
